statement.p: Its given that 43\cdot11=473. Use this fact to calculate the following without using a calculator.

solution.p: There is no operation symbol between 0.43 and -0.11, which implies multiplication.
Next, since positive times negative is negative, we know the answer must be negative. Now we can focus on calculating 0.43 \cdot 0.11, and in the end add back the negative symbol.
Its given that 43\cdot11=473. We need to calculate 0.43 \cdot 0.11.

li.p: To change 43 to 0.43, we moved the decimal point to the left by 2 place(s).
To change 11 to 0.11, we moved the decimal point to the left by 2 place(s).
We move the decimal point of 473 to the left by 2+2=4 places to get 0.43\cdot0.11=0.0473.
